ReducerPeakStreaming.Rule: ReducerPalacePeakGBEstimate of every reducer stage: SafetyFactor x PalaceGBPerGiB x (NodeBaselineGiB + (NodeUsedGiBPerMillionH1 + NodeUsedGiBPerMillionH1PerSource x sources) x H1 / 1e6), a node-used line fit by least squares on the 60 measured reducer node-used peaks of the stage-2 2026-10-05/06 (coupons-a, coupons-bc, pair 5) runs (every order, 8-source controls and the main stages); SafetyFactor = the largest measured / fitted ratio (decision 458), so the line covers every measured reducer; the per-source term is the resident archived fields (~8 bytes per H1 DOF per source)

Previous.Rule: the line of the previous model (library-device-thin-01's reducers, USER decision 2026-09-22 (B))

Previous.Provenance: the model every qualify run up to this refit used: Measured per-stage cost rates of the Palace response worker / reducer / ordinary local-edge stages on one r8g.48xlarge node (192 ranks, frozen executable 170439c4a9fc5d5ce329310812055be5fb83a4a7f288024b57b3b83551cbe70b, streaming one-pass Gram reducer at block size 48) refit by refit_cost_model.py from the 6-coupon device library qualification library-qualification.json (tool commit 7c7bb5fe5, PBS 47080, 47081, 47082, 47083, 47084, 47086, 47105, 47106, 47107, 47108, 47109, 47110, 47207, 47212, 47213, 47214, 47215, 47216, 47218, 47219, 47250, 47256, 47289, 47290, 47291, 47298, 47300, 47301, 47335, 47336, 47348, 47349, 47356, 47358, 47467). Every rate is on the reference mesh spatial-3-edge-5d3b5e644745 and is the LARGEST the run's coupons imply once scaled to it by the exact H1 ratio (fail-closed: the 1x estimate is at least the measured wall of every stage of every coupon; SelfCheck). estimate_stages.py scales them to another hybrid prism-tube coupon mesh by the exact H1 DOF ratio with 1x / 1.5x / 2x the measured mean PCG counts.

Rule.Memory: per-node node-used GiB at N nodes = the one-node figure x (ReplicatedFraction + (1 - ReplicatedFraction) / N); ReplicatedFraction = 2 x per-node peak at 2 nodes / the one-node peak - 1, clamped to [0, 1], the largest over the measured stages of the kind
Rule.Time: T(N) = T(1) / N^Exponent with Exponent = log2(the measured 1 -> 2 node speedup of the part); estimate_stages caps it at 1 (no superlinear speedup is budgeted); a negative exponent (slower at 2 nodes) is kept

Ordinary.Basis: the larger of the Palace per-node peak fraction and the node-used fraction with the one-node node-used reconstructed (Palace peak / PalaceGBPerGiB + the 2-node per-node overhead); the one-node run of record ran outside the runner: no node-used sample

NodeScaling.PerNodeGuardMarginRule: decision 463: the estimated per-node peak stays under the admission guard by this margin; the measured per-node residuals (the p5 dense twin at 2 nodes peaked at 460.6 GiB against the 460.8 GiB m8g guard, i.e. the one-node Palace-peak-based estimate under-predicted the node-used peak by the per-node overhead) justify no less than 10 %

CapCheck.Rule: per measured coupon and stage: the measured wall, the cap of record (the run's plan) and the cap under the new model (CapSeconds = 2 x the estimate at the largest PCG factor, a block worker at its block's source count); a stage whose new cap is below its measured wall fails the refit (decision 458)
